title: A solution to the Erdős Problem #1040
summary: For a compact set $K\subset\mathbb{C}$, let $\vartheta(K)$ be the infimum of the planar areas of the unit lemniscates of all monic polynomials with zeros in $K$, allowing arbitrary degree and repeated zeros. We prove that $\vartheta(K)=0$ whenever $\operatorname{cap}(K)=1$, with no regularity assumption on $K$. The proof uses a centered harmonic polynomial that is positive on all but a set of arbitrarily small area in the polynomial hull of $K$. A Fourier average of exterior harmonic measures realizes this polynomial as the logarithmic potential of a signed measure having bounded density…
